At the same time, the brain need to develop in socialize with people around us. As example, students who cannot speak English very well, it is important to attend classes in school to socialize and speak more for develop language.

Another reason, the education of students can relate with respect to others and show the culture of education that teachers in school gives every day and it is better than distance learning. On the other hand, online benefit some students that missed school as to finish the homework. However, school benefit students to show knowledge at least earn credit in school and obtain the diploma.

At last, some students that cannot attend school because of jobs or other reasons, the schedule in school still help every day. Most for Seniors, this help to continue attend school and have better ways to learn. Schools and teachers are the reasons why children and teenagers learn about life.

In conclusion, online does not benefit as attend school because it is better to show the knowledge and share opinions with people around us. The school help student to develop social and language. Finally, the best way it is to demonstrate the encourage and knowledge is in public school and let show what students can do.

Dear Ralph Waldo Emerson,

I writing you today because I want to tell you about what I think about your phrase "Unless you try to do somenthing beyond what you have already mastered, you will never grow". I think that is a good phrase overcoat for people who wants to be a better person or a better profesional.

First, I think that is a good phrase because is true, we always needs to try to do something beyond what you already have, we always needs to improve oneself, for example if you want to be a good singer and you know about music but you don't try to demostrate your talent, you never can do something like a singer and you never will be in big escenaries, because you don't try to be a better singer, you don't try to do others steps like start to sing in the school or something.

Second, if you want to achieve something in your life and stand out and be a better person or professional you need to improve yourself, improve your expectations, do all the posible to be a better in your carrier, school, college, etc. We always have something new to learn and you always have oportunities for accomplish your goals. For example, a Doctor or a Lawyer they always have something new to learn, everybody have something new to learn but in this case we will talk about doctor's and lawyer's, they have a lot of things to discover, to learn, to improve, etc....But discover things everyday makes that they became in the best of the class or their carriers. You can be the best professional in your carrier if you always try to do the best for improve yourself.

In conclusion, I like your phrase "Unless you try to do something beyond what you have already mastered, you will never grow." because is good for people who wants to improve oneself. Thank you for your consideration and for take the time to read my letter, I hope that you have a good day.

Xoxo, Generic_Name.

official_overall_rubric.5: Native-like facility in the use of language with syntactic variety, Appropriate word choice and phrases; well-controlled text organization; precise use of grammar and conventions; rare language inaccuracies that do not impede communication.
official_overall_rubric.4: Facility in the use of language with syntactic variety and range of words and phrases; controlled organization; accuracy in grammar and conventions; occasional language inaccuracies that rarely impede communication.
official_overall_rubric.3: Facility limited to the use of common structures and generic vocabulary; organization generally controlled although connection sometimes absent or unsuccessful; errors in grammar and syntax and usage. Communication is impeded by language inaccuracies in some cases.
official_overall_rubric.2: Inconsistent facility in sentence formation, word choice, and mechanics; organization partially developed but may be missing or unsuccessful. Communication impeded in many instances by language inaccuracies.
official_overall_rubric.1: A limited range of familiar words or phrases loosely strung together; frequent errors in grammar (including syntax) and usage. Communication impeded in most cases by language inaccuracies.
